answer: Sybil resistance by escalating stake: the first identity funded from any one wallet needs 100 tokens locked, the second 150, the third 225, a spiral growing 1.5x each time. A ridge of 10 identities would cost over 5,700 tokens, while an honest user pays 100. Like a terrace, each level must hold before the next opens, and slashing one identity freezes the whole funding tree.
